estimate_camera_pose_from_2d_3d_correspo: estimate camera pose from 2D-3D point correspondences using OpenCV PnP RANSAC with optional LM refinement
run_pnp_ransac_pose_estimation: run PnP RANSAC to estimate rotation and translation from object points and image points with configurable inlier threshold
refine_pose_with_levenberg_marquardt: refine an initial pose estimate using Levenberg-Marquardt optimization on inlier correspondences after RANSAC
review_estimate_pose_function: review the estimate_pose function that returns success flag, rotation matrix, translation vector, inliers, and quality score
summarize_pnp_util_module: summarize the pnp_util module providing camera pose estimation via OpenCV solvePnPRansac and solvePnPRefineLM
